purpose: Local T1 throughput benchmark on synthetic features, dates and coordinates. No comparable local accuracy is measured.
train_timing_definition: From first loss call through end of training updates each epoch, synchronized before validation; includes all later batch assembly and copies.
evaluation_timing_definition: Separate prediction entry including load, checkpoint restoration, search, and output.
estimated_time_note: Linear extrapolation from the last two synthetic epochs, excluding one-time data loading and saving, measured with a smaller feature cache.
